source_documents.title: Original job post
source_documents.text: Penbrothers seeks a product-minded Full Stack Engineer to build and ship end-to-end product experiences across frontend, backend, cloud infrastructure, and product execution. The posting specifies React, Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, APIs, databases, AWS/serverless systems, deployment, monitoring, and AI-assisted development, with a minimum of 5+ years of professional software engineering experience.

responsibilities.text: Build and deliver end-to-end product features across frontend, backend, APIs, databases, and cloud environments.
Own the full development lifecycle including implementation, testing, deployment, monitoring, debugging, and continuous improvement.
Prototype and iterate quickly by translating product ideas into working solutions.

requirements.text: Minimum 5+ years of professional software engineering experience.
Strong experience building and maintaining web applications from frontend to backend.
Experience working with cloud environments, preferably AWS.
Ability to independently take ownership of features and deliver solutions.

entries.notes: Applied through Indeed for the fully remote Full Stack Engineer role at Penbrothers. Indeed URL: https://ph.indeed.com/viewjob?jk=2267594ba7832cc1&from=shareddesktop_copy. The role is full-time, day shift 9:00 AM-6:00 PM Philippine time with flexible AEST overlap. Verified requirements include React, Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, APIs, databases, AWS/serverless systems, product ownership, deployment, monitoring, and AI-assisted development. A cover letter PDF was created at records/cover-letter-penbrothers-full-stack-engineer.pdf and includes the portfolio URL www.justintagarda.com. Application questions were answered regarding identity verification consent, Indeed as the source, no referral, other pending applications, availability, prior Penbrothers employment, contact methods, and end-to-end product experience. A prior JobStreet application for the same or closely matching Penbrothers role was cancelled; this Indeed application was subsequently submitted. Penbrothers acknowledgment email from noreply@recruiterflowmail.com confirmed receipt of the Full Stack Engineer application and stated that the team will review it and respond shortly. Penbrothers Talent Acquisition Team email from talentacquisition@penbrothers.com confirmed applications are under review; candidates whose qualifications closely match may receive a link to an initial AI interview to complete at their convenience, and applications may be retained for future opportunities. Indeed applications generally do not require a cover letter unless the employer separately requests one.

entries.reply_draft:
Subject: Re: Senior Full Stack Developer - 855391

Hi Dex,

Thank you for reaching out and for the opportunity to provide more information about my background. Please see my answers below.

1. Commercial software experience
I have more than 15 years of experience building and supporting commercial and business-critical software, including production APIs, internal business systems, ERP workflows, customer portals, dashboards, and desktop applications. My responsibilities have covered requirements analysis, system and database design, backend and frontend development, API integration, deployment, troubleshooting, maintenance, and production support.

2. Java, Spring, Spring Boot, and React
My primary professional backend experience is in C#, .NET, ASP.NET, and SQL Server. I also have some experience with Java and Spring, although I am not yet an expert in those technologies. My strong foundation in backend development, software architecture, React, and multiple programming environments allows me to become productive with new frameworks quickly. I have professional React experience with React and Next.js interfaces integrated with .NET REST APIs, authentication flows, dashboards, and data-driven workflows.

3. Spring WebFlux
My production API experience has primarily been with .NET rather than Spring WebFlux. However, I have experience designing backend services, integrating APIs, supporting asynchronous application workflows, and maintaining production systems. These fundamentals are transferable to Spring WebFlux.

4. GraphQL and REST APIs
My strongest API experience is with REST APIs using C# and .NET/ASP.NET. I have built and maintained APIs for business workflows, authentication, dashboards, integrations, and customer-facing applications, including deployment and production support. My direct GraphQL experience is limited, but my experience with API design, data modeling, authentication, and backend architecture gives me a strong foundation for adopting GraphQL.

5. AI-assisted development
I use ChatGPT and GitHub Copilot for code exploration, implementation, refactoring, test planning, documentation, and troubleshooting. I verify generated output through code review, requirements and architecture checks, builds and tests where available, and manual behavior validation. I remain responsible for the code’s correctness, security, and maintainability.

6. GCP, GKE, Docker, and containerized applications
I have hands-on experience with Docker, IIS, Windows Server, SQL Server, deployments, monitoring, server migrations, and production incident support. I have also used Google Cloud services for authentication in other projects, including configuring authentication flows and integrating them into applications. My GCP experience is focused on authentication rather than GKE administration or broader cloud infrastructure, while my strongest infrastructure experience is with Windows Server, IIS, Docker, and Azure DevOps workflows.

7. Modern full-stack tools and frameworks
My professional experience includes TypeScript, React, Next.js, JavaScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Docker, Git, GitHub, Jira, xUnit, PostgreSQL, and production build and deployment workflows. My React projects use Vite, and I use GitHub extensively for source control, collaboration, and project delivery. My Flutter projects use Flutter’s Material design widgets.

I have not used some of the other listed tools professionally, including React Material UI, Redux Toolkit, RTK Query, JOOQ, Redis, Flyway, Google Pub/Sub, GitHub Actions, Keycloak, Vitest, React Testing Library, Jest, Testcontainers, and Mockito. However, my experience across backend services, React development, testing, databases, and production delivery enables me to adopt new tools effectively.

8. Earliest availability
I am available to start immediately, subject to completing the hiring and onboarding process.

9. CET-aligned schedule
Yes. I can commit to a full-time schedule aligned with Central European Time and the stated UK business hours, including the expected Philippine mid-shift schedule.

10. Employment terms
Yes. I am amenable to the permanent, full-time, work-from-home arrangement, the PHP 140,000–150,000 gross monthly salary range, mandatory Philippine government contributions, and the stated benefits. I understand that I will need to use my own computer or laptop.

My strongest alignment is in production .NET backend and full-stack delivery, REST APIs, React/TypeScript, authentication integrations, Docker, deployment, and operational support. I would welcome the opportunity to contribute this experience while continuing to deepen my Java/Spring and Google Cloud expertise.

Thank you for your consideration. I look forward to hearing from you.

Best regards,
Justiniano Tagarda
